IRON YARD -- one-time owner-requested PUBLIC Roblox v59 update, 13 November 2026.

Target ONLY the already PUBLIC creator-owned IRON YARD Roblox experience.
Source base is PUBLIC v58, accepted as Roblox place version 54 by
workflow 43444851101. Never create a new, private or replacement
experience. Never change universe, root place or PUBLIC visibility.

Purpose: deploy the focused safety and graphics reliability fix in
PR #88, commit 56f76ee4979280b84cff6d287b0d9964a90fc1cf.
A tagged gameplay part can lose its approved material key or change
base Material during replication, streaming, or a rebuilt arena.
The client now removes only an exact whitelisted IRON YARD PBR
MaterialVariant when its authorization becomes invalid. It also
responds to real Enum.Material changes and tag removals, while leaving
unrelated custom MaterialVariants untouched. Existing ECO/BALANCED/
QUALITY handling and the native Roblox fallback remain unchanged.

No new uploaded 3D models or textures. Keep all original 26 owner-
approved asset IDs (10 weapons, 4 VANGUARD, 12 world images).
No changes to hitboxes, damage, matchmaking, input, progression or
gameplay physics. CI verifies the Luau policy and the wiring; real
Android GPU and visual QA still requires a separate runtime check.

Authorize exactly ONE release to the current owner-controlled PUBLIC
place only after a fresh successful main Rojo build for the exact
authorization commit. Independently verify universe, place, creator,
existing PUBLIC visibility, source SHA, and successful Roblox place
version response; refuse stale or unexpected targets. No automated
asset upload or duplicate releases.
